flux/apps/cloud-fort/   (chart 0.3.0)
● forts/
  ● kustomization.yaml           namespace + postgres
  ● namespace.yaml               Namespace forts: every provider the fort runs
  ● postgres/
    ● cluster.yaml               CNPG Cluster postgres: greenfield, barman archive to B2 (plugin), roles via patches
    ● database-sfi-website.yaml  Database CR
    ● forts.contract.yaml        secrets-backup (the fort's B2 db-physical key, external) + secrets-sfi-website
    ● kustomization.yaml         patches: role-sfi-website.yaml
    ● objectstore.yaml           ObjectStore b2: s3://sfi-db-physical-backups/cloud-fort, the fort's own key
    ● role-sfi-website.yaml      JSON6902 add /spec/managed/roles/-
    ● scheduled-backup.yaml      nightly base backup via the plugin (stagger the hour by hand)
    ◆ secrets-backup.sops.yaml   seeded
    ◆ secrets-sfi-website.sops.yaml seeded

  ● certificate-sfi-website.yaml letsencrypt, sfi-website.cloud-fort.example.cloud

  ● kustomization.yaml           patches: listener-sfi-website.yaml
  ● listener-sfi-website.yaml    JSON6902 add /spec/listeners/- (https-sfi-website)
  ● redirect-https.yaml          catch-all http→https 301
○ kustomization.yaml             + gateway, forts, sfi-website

  ● forts.contract.yaml          pre-`fort seed` full form, 3 keys

  ● namespace.yaml

staged. next: seed the ◆ files (dependency order is derived):
  fort seed cloud-fort --write
external keys — absent from the Secret until set (sops set, or a sops/env ref in the contract):
  RESEND_API_KEY           Resend → API keys (re_) (optional)
  ACCESS_KEY_ID            postgres: `fort b2-key db-physical cloud-fort --write`, then `fort seed cloud-fort postgres --set ACCESS_KEY_ID --write`
  ACCESS_SECRET_KEY        postgres: the same mint; `fort seed cloud-fort postgres --set ACCESS_SECRET_KEY --write`
then: review, commit, PR — flux applies on merge.
